remarks:
This 1818 Home has been immaculately maintained.  Conveniently located in the Village of Alfred with easy access to both campuses.  From the Front Entry, there are Two rooms which have lots of different potential.  They could be Bedrooms, offices, family room etc.  They are currently used for an antique business displaying a lot of inventory.  A full bath convenient on the first floor with tub/shower. Formal Dining room great for entertaining. Remodeled kitchen with plenty of cupboard space. There is a back stairway to the upstairs.  Also, a walk-in pantry area and laundry are located off the kitchen. Living room is very large and a gas fireplace and lots of windows for natural light.  There is an attached garage with workshop space extra storage and a pulldown stairway to additional storage.  There is access from this garage to the inground pool located off the Sunroom. This garage leads to another garage space and a small garage perfect for lawn mower and tools attached to the house. There is also a Sunroom area off the laundry area that is heated with a Gas FP; and has sliding doors to the pool area. Perfect place to just relax.
Upstairs there are two front Bedrooms each with walk in closets.  On the back side there are two more bedrooms.  The primary has two large closets.  The other room is currently used as a library, so lots of shelving.  Attic access from this room.
 The woodwork in this home is amazing.... a Must-See home!
Delayed negotiations until 5:00PM 9/10/2026
Square footage is from floor plan, not county records.
